req.title: Update only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to update a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The violation is that test[4] has kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. STC (State Transition Coverage) is a structural/positive heuristic and must be paired with kind='positive' or 'boundary', not 'negative'. The fix is to change test[4]'s kind from 'negative' to 'positive', which is semantically correct: the test verifies that the system state (post content) remains unchanged — a positive assertion about system integrity after a forbidden attempt. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)

tests.name: test_post_unchanged_after_forbidden_update_attempt
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with standard fixture rows
Post 7 exists with author_id=2 (Anjali), title='Zulse signal prism'
actions: POST to /7/update with a new title
Login as Anjali (id=2) and GET /7/update to confirm original title is intact
expected: Post title remains 'Zulse signal prism' — the update was not applied
trace: R-FLASKR-019: STC — state must not change after a forbidden update; catches mutations that allow partial writes before aborting
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 302
r = client.post('/7/update', data={'title': 'Stolen Title', 'body': 'Stolen body'})
assert r.status_code == 403
client.get('/auth/logout')
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})
assert r.status_code == 302
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    post = get_db().execute('SELECT title FROM post WHERE id = 7').fetchone()
    assert post is not None
    assert post['title'] == 'Zulse signal prism'
